fr: Prononciation et orthographe

L'orthographe anglaise note mal la prononciation : une même lettre a plusieurs sons (cat, cake, car, call) et un même son plusieurs graphies (see, sea, me, piece). Apprenez chaque mot avec sa prononciation.
Sons propres à l'anglais : « th » (think, sans voix ; this, avec voix), voyelles brèves et longues qui distinguent les mots (ship / sheep, full / fool), « h » toujours aspiré (house), « r » sans roulement.
Lettres muettes : know, write, hour, island.
La terminaison -ed se dit /t/ après un son sourd (worked), /d/ après un son sonore (played), /ɪd/ après t ou d (wanted).
L'anglais accentue les mots importants et réduit les petits mots : « to », « of », « and » deviennent très brefs.
en: Pronunciation and spelling

English spelling is a poor guide to sound: one letter has several sounds (cat, cake, car, call) and one sound several spellings (see, sea, me, piece). Learn each word with its pronunciation.
Typical sounds: “th” (think, voiceless; this, voiced), short and long vowels that tell words apart (ship / sheep, full / fool), “h” always breathed (house), an unrolled “r”.
Silent letters: know, write, hour, island.
The -ed ending sounds /t/ after a voiceless sound (worked), /d/ after a voiced sound (played), /ɪd/ after t or d (wanted).
English stresses the important words and shrinks the small ones: “to”, “of”, “and” become very short.
es: Pronunciación y ortografía

La ortografía inglesa refleja mal la pronunciación: una letra tiene varios sonidos (cat, cake, car, call) y un sonido varias grafías (see, sea, me, piece). Aprende cada palabra con su pronunciación.
Sonidos típicos: «th» (think, sordo; this, sonoro), vocales breves y largas que distinguen palabras (ship / sheep, full / fool), «h» siempre aspirada (house), «r» sin vibrar.
Letras mudas: know, write, hour, island.
La terminación -ed suena /t/ tras un sonido sordo (worked), /d/ tras uno sonoro (played), /ɪd/ tras t o d (wanted).
El inglés acentúa las palabras importantes y reduce las pequeñas: «to», «of», «and» se vuelven muy breves.
de: Aussprache und Rechtschreibung

Die englische Schreibung gibt die Aussprache schlecht wieder: Ein Buchstabe hat mehrere Laute (cat, cake, car, call), ein Laut mehrere Schreibweisen (see, sea, me, piece). Lerne jedes Wort mit seiner Aussprache.
Typische Laute: „th“ (think, stimmlos; this, stimmhaft), kurze und lange Vokale, die Wörter unterscheiden (ship / sheep, full / fool), „h“ immer gehaucht (house), ungerolltes „r“.
Stumme Buchstaben: know, write, hour, island.
Die Endung -ed klingt /t/ nach stimmlosem Laut (worked), /d/ nach stimmhaftem (played), /ɪd/ nach t oder d (wanted).
Das Englische betont die wichtigen Wörter und verkürzt die kleinen: „to“, „of“, „and“ werden sehr kurz.
it: Pronuncia e ortografia

L'ortografia inglese rende male la pronuncia: una lettera ha più suoni (cat, cake, car, call) e un suono più grafie (see, sea, me, piece). Impara ogni parola con la sua pronuncia.
Suoni tipici: «th» (think, sordo; this, sonoro), vocali brevi e lunghe che distinguono le parole (ship / sheep, full / fool), «h» sempre aspirata (house), «r» non vibrata.
Lettere mute: know, write, hour, island.
La desinenza -ed si pronuncia /t/ dopo un suono sordo (worked), /d/ dopo uno sonoro (played), /ɪd/ dopo t o d (wanted).
L'inglese accentua le parole importanti e riduce quelle piccole: «to», «of», «and» diventano brevissime.
pt: Pronúncia e ortografia

A ortografia inglesa reflete mal a pronúncia: uma letra tem vários sons (cat, cake, car, call) e um som várias grafias (see, sea, me, piece). Aprenda cada palavra com sua pronúncia.
Sons típicos: «th» (think, surdo; this, sonoro), vogais curtas e longas que distinguem palavras (ship / sheep, full / fool), «h» sempre aspirado (house), «r» sem vibração.
Letras mudas: know, write, hour, island.
A terminação -ed soa /t/ depois de som surdo (worked), /d/ depois de som sonoro (played), /ɪd/ depois de t ou d (wanted).
O inglês acentua as palavras importantes e reduz as pequenas: «to», «of», «and» ficam muito curtas.
ja: 発音とつづり

英語のつづりは発音をよく表していません。一つの文字に複数の音があり（cat, cake, car, call）、一つの音に複数のつづりがあります（see, sea, me, piece）。単語は発音といっしょに覚えましょう。
英語らしい音：「th」（think は無声、this は有声）、語を区別する短母音と長母音（ship / sheep, full / fool）、いつも息を出す「h」（house）、巻かない「r」。
発音しない文字：know, write, hour, island。
語尾 -ed は無声音の後で /t/（worked）、有声音の後で /d/（played）、t・d の後で /ɪd/（wanted）。
英語は大事な語を強く、小さな語を弱く発音します。「to」「of」「and」はとても短くなります。
zh: 发音与拼写

英语拼写不能很好地反映发音：一个字母有多种读音（cat, cake, car, call），一个音有多种拼法（see, sea, me, piece）。每个单词都要连同发音一起记。
英语特有的音：「th」（think 清音，this 浊音），区分词义的长短元音（ship / sheep, full / fool），总要送气的「h」（house），不打舌的「r」。
不发音的字母：know, write, hour, island。
词尾 -ed 在清音后读 /t/（worked），在浊音后读 /d/（played），在 t、d 后读 /ɪd/（wanted）。
英语重读重要的词，弱读小词：「to」「of」「and」会读得很短。
ko: 발음과 철자

영어 철자는 발음을 잘 나타내지 못합니다. 한 글자에 여러 소리가 있고(cat, cake, car, call), 한 소리에 여러 철자가 있습니다(see, sea, me, piece). 단어는 발음과 함께 외우세요.
영어다운 소리: 「th」(think는 무성음, this는 유성음), 뜻을 구별하는 짧은 모음과 긴 모음(ship / sheep, full / fool), 항상 숨을 내쉬는 「h」(house), 굴리지 않는 「r」.
소리 나지 않는 글자: know, write, hour, island.
어미 -ed는 무성음 뒤에서 /t/(worked), 유성음 뒤에서 /d/(played), t나 d 뒤에서 /ɪd/(wanted)로 소리 납니다.
영어는 중요한 단어를 강하게, 작은 단어를 약하게 발음합니다. 「to」, 「of」, 「and」는 아주 짧아집니다.
lt: Tarimas ir rašyba

Anglų rašyba prastai atspindi tarimą: viena raidė turi kelis garsus (cat, cake, car, call), vienas garsas – kelias rašybas (see, sea, me, piece). Kiekvieną žodį mokykitės kartu su tarimu.
Būdingi garsai: „th“ (think – duslus, this – skardus), trumpieji ir ilgieji balsiai, skiriantys žodžius (ship / sheep, full / fool), visada aspiruotas „h“ (house), nevirpinamas „r“.
Netariamos raidės: know, write, hour, island.
Galūnė -ed tariama /t/ po duslaus garso (worked), /d/ po skardaus (played), /ɪd/ po t arba d (wanted).
Anglai kirčiuoja svarbius žodžius, o mažuosius ištaria labai trumpai: „to“, „of“, „and“.
tl: Pagbigkas at baybay

Hindi tapat ang baybay ng Ingles sa bigkas: isang titik ay may ilang tunog (cat, cake, car, call) at isang tunog ay may ilang baybay (see, sea, me, piece). Pag-aralan ang bawat salita kasama ang bigkas nito.
Mga karaniwang tunog: «th» (think, walang tinig; this, may tinig), maikli at mahabang patinig na nag-iiba ng salita (ship / sheep, full / fool), «h» na laging may hininga (house), «r» na hindi pinapagulong.
Mga titik na hindi binibigkas: know, write, hour, island.
Ang hulaping -ed ay /t/ pagkatapos ng tunog na walang tinig (worked), /d/ pagkatapos ng may tinig (played), /ɪd/ pagkatapos ng t o d (wanted).
Diniinan ng Ingles ang mahahalagang salita at pinaiikli ang maliliit: «to», «of», «and».

fr: Le verbe « be » au présent

« Be » (être) a trois formes au présent : I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. À l'oral on contracte : I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
Négation : on ajoute « not » (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Question : on inverse le verbe et le sujet (Are you ready?).
Attention : l'anglais emploie « be » pour l'âge, la faim, le froid : I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.
en: The verb “be” in the present

“Be” has three present forms: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. In speech they contract: I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
Negative: add “not” (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Question: swap verb and subject (Are you ready?).
English uses “be” for age, hunger and cold: I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.
es: El verbo «be» en presente

«Be» (ser / estar) tiene tres formas en presente: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. Al hablar se contraen: I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
Negación: se añade «not» (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Pregunta: se invierte verbo y sujeto (Are you ready?).
El inglés usa «be» para la edad, el hambre y el frío: I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.
de: Das Verb „be“ im Präsens

„Be“ (sein) hat drei Präsensformen: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. Gesprochen wird zusammengezogen: I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
Verneinung: „not“ anhängen (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Frage: Verb und Subjekt tauschen (Are you ready?).
Englisch benutzt „be“ für Alter, Hunger und Kälte: I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.
it: Il verbo «be» al presente

«Be» (essere) ha tre forme al presente: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. Parlando si contrae: I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
Negazione: si aggiunge «not» (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Domanda: si invertono verbo e soggetto (Are you ready?).
L'inglese usa «be» per l'età, la fame e il freddo: I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.
pt: O verbo «be» no presente

«Be» (ser / estar) tem três formas no presente: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. Na fala contraem-se: I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
Negação: acrescenta-se «not» (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Pergunta: inverte-se verbo e sujeito (Are you ready?).
O inglês usa «be» para idade, fome e frio: I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.
ja: be動詞（現在形）

「be」（〜である、〜にいる）は現在形に三つの形があります：I am、he / she / it is、you / we / they are。話し言葉では短くなります：I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're。
否定は「not」をつけます（is not = isn't, are not = aren't）。疑問文は動詞と主語を入れかえます（Are you ready?）。
年齢・空腹・寒さにも be を使います：I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold。
zh: 动词 be 的现在时

「be」（是、在）现在时有三种形式：I am，he / she / it is，you / we / they are。口语中常缩写：I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're。
否定：加「not」（is not = isn't，are not = aren't）。疑问：把动词和主语调换位置（Are you ready?）。
英语用 be 表达年龄、饥饿和寒冷：I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold。
ko: be 동사의 현재형

「be」(~이다, ~에 있다)는 현재형이 셋입니다: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. 말할 때는 줄여 씁니다: I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
부정: 「not」을 붙입니다(is not = isn't, are not = aren't). 의문문: 동사와 주어의 자리를 바꿉니다(Are you ready?).
나이, 배고픔, 추위에도 be를 씁니다: I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.
lt: Veiksmažodis „be“ esamuoju laiku

„Be“ (būti) esamajame laike turi tris formas: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. Šnekant sutrumpinama: I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
Neiginys: pridedamas „not“ (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Klausimas: sukeičiami veiksmažodis ir veiksnys (Are you ready?).
Anglai vartoja „be“ amžiui, alkiui ir šalčiui: I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.
tl: Ang pandiwang «be» sa kasalukuyan

Ang «be» ay may tatlong anyo sa kasalukuyan: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are. Sa pagsasalita, pinaiikli: I'm, you're, he's, we're, they're.
Negatibo: idagdag ang «not» (is not = isn't, are not = aren't). Tanong: pagpalitin ang pandiwa at simuno (Are you ready?).
Ginagamit ang «be» para sa edad, gutom at lamig: I am twenty, I am hungry, I am cold.

fr: Les articles : a, an, the

« A » devant un son de consonne (a book, a university), « an » devant un son de voyelle (an apple, an hour). Ils signifient « un, une » et ne s'emploient qu'au singulier.
« The » (le, la, les) ne change jamais. On l'emploie pour ce qui est connu ou déjà mentionné.
Pas d'article pour parler des choses en général : I like music. Dogs are friendly.
en: Articles: a, an, the

Use “a” before a consonant sound (a book, a university) and “an” before a vowel sound (an apple, an hour). They are only used in the singular.
“The” never changes. Use it for something known or already mentioned.
No article when speaking in general: I like music. Dogs are friendly.
es: Los artículos: a, an, the

«A» delante de un sonido consonántico (a book, a university), «an» delante de un sonido vocálico (an apple, an hour). Significan «un, una» y solo se usan en singular.
«The» (el, la, los, las) nunca cambia. Se usa para lo conocido o ya mencionado.
Sin artículo para hablar en general: I like music. Dogs are friendly.
de: Die Artikel: a, an, the

„A“ vor einem Konsonantenlaut (a book, a university), „an“ vor einem Vokallaut (an apple, an hour). Sie bedeuten „ein, eine“ und stehen nur im Singular.
„The“ (der, die, das) ändert sich nie. Man benutzt es für Bekanntes oder schon Erwähntes.
Kein Artikel bei allgemeinen Aussagen: I like music. Dogs are friendly.
it: Gli articoli: a, an, the

«A» davanti a un suono consonantico (a book, a university), «an» davanti a un suono vocalico (an apple, an hour). Significano «un, una» e si usano solo al singolare.
«The» (il, la, i, le) non cambia mai. Si usa per ciò che è noto o già menzionato.
Niente articolo per parlare in generale: I like music. Dogs are friendly.
pt: Os artigos: a, an, the

«A» antes de som de consoante (a book, a university), «an» antes de som de vogal (an apple, an hour). Significam «um, uma» e só se usam no singular.
«The» (o, a, os, as) nunca muda. Usa-se para o que é conhecido ou já mencionado.
Sem artigo para falar em geral: I like music. Dogs are friendly.
ja: 冠詞：a, an, the

子音の音の前は「a」（a book, a university）、母音の音の前は「an」（an apple, an hour）。「一つの」という意味で、単数にだけ使います。
「the」は形が変わりません。すでに知っているもの、話に出たものに使います。
一般的なことを言うときは冠詞をつけません：I like music. Dogs are friendly.
zh: 冠词：a、an、the

辅音音素前用「a」（a book, a university），元音音素前用「an」（an apple, an hour）。意思是「一个」，只用于单数。
「the」（这个、那个）形式不变，用于已知或已提到的事物。
泛指时不用冠词：I like music. Dogs are friendly.
ko: 관사: a, an, the

자음 소리 앞에는 「a」(a book, a university), 모음 소리 앞에는 「an」(an apple, an hour)을 씁니다. '하나의'라는 뜻이며 단수에만 씁니다.
「the」는 형태가 바뀌지 않습니다. 이미 알거나 앞에서 말한 것에 씁니다.
일반적인 이야기를 할 때는 관사를 쓰지 않습니다: I like music. Dogs are friendly.
lt: Artikeliai: a, an, the

„A“ prieš priebalsio garsą (a book, a university), „an“ prieš balsio garsą (an apple, an hour). Jie reiškia „vienas, kažkoks“ ir vartojami tik vienaskaitoje.
„The“ niekada nekinta. Jis vartojamas tam, kas žinoma ar jau paminėta.
Kalbant apskritai artikelio nėra: I like music. Dogs are friendly.
tl: Mga pantukoy: a, an, the

«A» bago ang tunog-katinig (a book, a university), «an» bago ang tunog-patinig (an apple, an hour). Ibig sabihin ay «isang» at pang-isahan lamang.
Hindi nagbabago ang «the». Ginagamit ito sa kilala o nabanggit na.
Walang pantukoy kapag pangkalahatan: I like music. Dogs are friendly.

fr: Le pluriel des noms

On ajoute -s : book → books. Après -s, -x, -ch, -sh, on ajoute -es : box → boxes. Consonne + y → -ies : city → cities. -f / -fe → -ves : knife → knives.
Quelques pluriels irréguliers : man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.
L'adjectif ne prend jamais de -s : two big houses.
en: Plural nouns

Add -s: book → books. After -s, -x, -ch, -sh add -es: box → boxes. Consonant + y → -ies: city → cities. -f / -fe → -ves: knife → knives.
Some irregular plurals: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.
Adjectives never take -s: two big houses.
es: El plural de los sustantivos

Se añade -s: book → books. Tras -s, -x, -ch, -sh se añade -es: box → boxes. Consonante + y → -ies: city → cities. -f / -fe → -ves: knife → knives.
Algunos plurales irregulares: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.
El adjetivo nunca lleva -s: two big houses.
de: Der Plural der Nomen

Man hängt -s an: book → books. Nach -s, -x, -ch, -sh kommt -es: box → boxes. Konsonant + y → -ies: city → cities. -f / -fe → -ves: knife → knives.
Einige unregelmäßige Plurale: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.
Das Adjektiv bekommt nie ein -s: two big houses.
it: Il plurale dei nomi

Si aggiunge -s: book → books. Dopo -s, -x, -ch, -sh si aggiunge -es: box → boxes. Consonante + y → -ies: city → cities. -f / -fe → -ves: knife → knives.
Alcuni plurali irregolari: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.
L'aggettivo non prende mai la -s: two big houses.
pt: O plural dos substantivos

Acrescenta-se -s: book → books. Depois de -s, -x, -ch, -sh acrescenta-se -es: box → boxes. Consoante + y → -ies: city → cities. -f / -fe → -ves: knife → knives.
Alguns plurais irregulares: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.
O adjetivo nunca leva -s: two big houses.
ja: 名詞の複数形

-s をつけます：book → books。-s, -x, -ch, -sh で終わる語は -es：box → boxes。子音 + y は -ies：city → cities。-f / -fe は -ves：knife → knives。
不規則な複数形：man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people。
形容詞には -s をつけません：two big houses。
zh: 名词的复数

一般加 -s：book → books。以 -s, -x, -ch, -sh 结尾加 -es：box → boxes。辅音 + y 变 -ies：city → cities。-f / -fe 变 -ves：knife → knives。
一些不规则复数：man → men，woman → women，child → children，foot → feet，tooth → teeth，person → people。
形容词永远不加 -s：two big houses。
ko: 명사의 복수형

-s를 붙입니다: book → books. -s, -x, -ch, -sh 뒤에는 -es: box → boxes. 자음 + y는 -ies: city → cities. -f / -fe는 -ves: knife → knives.
불규칙 복수형: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.
형용사에는 절대 -s를 붙이지 않습니다: two big houses.
lt: Daiktavardžių daugiskaita

Pridedama -s: book → books. Po -s, -x, -ch, -sh pridedama -es: box → boxes. Priebalsis + y → -ies: city → cities. -f / -fe → -ves: knife → knives.
Kai kurios netaisyklingos daugiskaitos: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.
Būdvardis niekada negauna -s: two big houses.
tl: Ang maramihan ng pangngalan

Idagdag ang -s: book → books. Pagkatapos ng -s, -x, -ch, -sh, idagdag ang -es: box → boxes. Katinig + y → -ies: city → cities. -f / -fe → -ves: knife → knives.
Ilang di-regular: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people.

Negative with do / does + not: I don't work, she doesn't work (the verb loses its -s).
Question: Do you work? Does she work?
es: El presente simple

Negación con do / does + not: I don't work, she doesn't work (el verbo pierde la -s).

de: Das Simple Present

fr: Pronoms et possessifs

Sujets : I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Compléments : me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
Possessifs : my, your, his, her, its, our, their. Ils s'accordent avec le possesseur, pas avec la chose possédée : his sister = la sœur de lui, her brother = le frère d'elle.
Possession avec 's : Tom's car (la voiture de Tom).
en: Pronouns and possessives

Subjects: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Objects: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
Possessives: my, your, his, her, its, our, their. They agree with the owner, not with the thing owned: his sister, her brother.
Possession with 's: Tom's car.
es: Pronombres y posesivos

Sujeto: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Complemento: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
Posesivos: my, your, his, her, its, our, their. Concuerdan con el poseedor, no con lo poseído: his sister = la hermana de él, her brother = el hermano de ella.
Posesión con 's: Tom's car (el coche de Tom).
de: Pronomen und Possessivbegleiter

Subjekt: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Objekt: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
Possessiv: my, your, his, her, its, our, their. Sie richten sich nach dem Besitzer, nicht nach dem Besitz: his sister = seine Schwester, her brother = ihr Bruder.
Besitz mit 's: Tom's car (Toms Auto).
it: Pronomi e possessivi

Soggetto: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Complemento: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
Possessivi: my, your, his, her, its, our, their. Si accordano con il possessore, non con la cosa posseduta: his sister = la sorella di lui, her brother = il fratello di lei.
Possesso con 's: Tom's car (la macchina di Tom).
pt: Pronomes e possessivos

Sujeito: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Complemento: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
Possessivos: my, your, his, her, its, our, their. Concordam com o possuidor, não com a coisa possuída: his sister = a irmã dele, her brother = o irmão dela.
Posse com 's: Tom's car (o carro do Tom).
ja: 代名詞と所有格

主格：I, you, he, she, it, we, they。目的格：me, you, him, her, it, us, them。
所有格：my, your, his, her, its, our, their。持ち主に合わせ、持ち物には合わせません：his sister = 彼の姉妹、her brother = 彼女の兄弟。
's で所有を表します：Tom's car（トムの車）。
zh: 代词与物主代词

主格：I, you, he, she, it, we, they。宾格：me, you, him, her, it, us, them。
物主代词：my, your, his, her, its, our, their。随所有者变化，而不是随所属物：his sister = 他的姐妹，her brother = 她的兄弟。
用 's 表示所属：Tom's car（汤姆的车）。
ko: 대명사와 소유격

주격: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. 목적격: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
소유격: my, your, his, her, its, our, their. 소유한 물건이 아니라 소유자에 맞춥니다: his sister = 그의 누나, her brother = 그녀의 남동생.
's로 소유를 나타냅니다: Tom's car (톰의 차).
lt: Įvardžiai ir savybiniai žodžiai

Veiksnys: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Papildinys: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
Savybiniai: my, your, his, her, its, our, their. Jie derinami su savininku, o ne su daiktu: his sister = jo sesuo, her brother = jos brolis.
Priklausomybė su 's: Tom's car (Tomo automobilis).
tl: Panghalip at paari

Simuno: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Layon: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
Paari: my, your, his, her, its, our, their. Sumusunod sa may-ari, hindi sa inaari: his sister = kapatid niyang babae (lalaki ang may-ari), her brother = kapatid niyang lalaki (babae ang may-ari).

fr: Le présent continu

be + verbe en -ing : action en cours au moment où l'on parle. I am reading, she is sleeping, they are working.

Les verbes d'état (know, like, want, need) ne se mettent pas à cette forme.
en: The present continuous

be + verb-ing: an action in progress now. I am reading, she is sleeping, they are working.
Spelling: make → making, run → running.
Also used for near-future plans: I'm leaving tomorrow.
State verbs (know, like, want, need) are not used in this form.
es: El presente continuo

be + verbo en -ing: acción en curso en el momento en que se habla. I am reading, she is sleeping, they are working.
Ortografía: make → making, run → running.
También sirve para un plan cercano: I'm leaving tomorrow.
Los verbos de estado (know, like, want, need) no se usan en esta forma.
de: Das Present Continuous

be + Verb mit -ing: Handlung, die gerade abläuft. I am reading, she is sleeping, they are working.
Schreibung: make → making, run → running.
Auch für nahe Pläne: I'm leaving tomorrow.

it: Il present continuous

be + verbo in -ing: azione in corso mentre si parla. I am reading, she is sleeping, they are working.

pt: O present continuous

be + verbo em -ing: ação em curso no momento em que se fala. I am reading, she is sleeping, they are working.

Verbos de estado (know, like, want, need) não se usam nesta forma.

fr: Le prétérit (past simple)

en: The past simple

A finished action in the past. Regular verbs add -ed (worked, played, studied). Many common verbs are irregular: go → went, have → had, see → saw, do → did, take → took, come → came.
“Be”: was (I, he, she, it), were (you, we, they).
Negative and question with did: I didn't go. Did you see it? (the main verb stays in its base form).
es: El pasado simple (past simple)

Acción terminada en el pasado. Verbos regulares: + -ed (worked, played, studied). Muchos verbos frecuentes son irregulares: go → went, have → had, see → saw, do → did, take → took, come → came.
«Be»: was (I, he, she, it), were (you, we, they).
Negación y pregunta con did: I didn't go. Did you see it? (el verbo queda en su forma base).
de: Das Simple Past

„Be“: was (I, he, she, it), were (you, we, they).
Verneinung und Frage mit did: I didn't go. Did you see it? (das Verb bleibt in der Grundform).
it: Il passato semplice (past simple)

fr: Le present perfect

have / has + participe passé (worked, seen, been, done). Il relie le passé au présent : expérience (I have been to Japan), action récente dont le résultat compte (I've lost my keys), situation qui dure encore avec for / since (I have lived here for ten years / since 2015).
Avec une date passée précise (yesterday, in 2010), on emploie le prétérit, pas le present perfect.
en: The present perfect

have / has + past participle (worked, seen, been, done). It links past and present: experience (I have been to Japan), a recent action whose result matters (I've lost my keys), a situation still going on with for / since (I have lived here for ten years / since 2015).
With a finished time (yesterday, in 2010) use the past simple instead.
es: El present perfect

have / has + participio (worked, seen, been, done). Une el pasado con el presente: experiencia (I have been to Japan), acción reciente cuyo resultado importa (I've lost my keys), situación que sigue con for / since (I have lived here for ten years / since 2015).
Con una fecha pasada precisa (yesterday, in 2010) se usa el pasado simple, no el present perfect.
de: Das Present Perfect

have / has + Partizip (worked, seen, been, done). Es verbindet Vergangenheit und Gegenwart: Erfahrung (I have been to Japan), kürzlich Geschehenes mit Folgen (I've lost my keys), andauernde Situation mit for / since (I have lived here for ten years / since 2015).
Mit genauer Zeitangabe in der Vergangenheit (yesterday, in 2010) steht das Simple Past.
it: Il present perfect

have / has + participio (worked, seen, been, done). Collega passato e presente: esperienza (I have been to Japan), azione recente di cui conta il risultato (I've lost my keys), situazione che dura ancora con for / since (I have lived here for ten years / since 2015).
Con una data passata precisa (yesterday, in 2010) si usa il past simple.
pt: O present perfect

have / has + particípio (worked, seen, been, done). Liga o passado ao presente: experiência (I have been to Japan), ação recente cujo resultado importa (I've lost my keys), situação que continua com for / since (I have lived here for ten years / since 2015).
Com uma data passada precisa (yesterday, in 2010) usa-se o past simple.
ja: 現在完了形

have / has + 過去分詞（worked, seen, been, done）。過去と現在をつなぎます：経験（I have been to Japan）、結果が残る最近の動作（I've lost my keys）、for / since で今も続く状態（I have lived here for ten years / since 2015）。
過去のはっきりした時（yesterday, in 2010）がある場合は過去形を使います。
zh: 现在完成时

have / has + 过去分词（worked, seen, been, done）。连接过去和现在：经历（I have been to Japan），结果仍有影响的最近动作（I've lost my keys），用 for / since 表示持续到现在的情况（I have lived here for ten years / since 2015）。
有明确的过去时间（yesterday, in 2010）时用一般过去时。
ko: 현재완료

have / has + 과거분사(worked, seen, been, done). 과거와 현재를 이어 줍니다: 경험(I have been to Japan), 결과가 남아 있는 최근 동작(I've lost my keys), for / since로 지금까지 계속되는 상황(I have lived here for ten years / since 2015).

lt: Esamasis atliktinis laikas

have / has + dalyvis (worked, seen, been, done). Jis jungia praeitį su dabartimi: patirtis (I have been to Japan), neseniai įvykęs veiksmas su pasekme (I've lost my keys), tebesitęsianti būsena su for / since (I have lived here for ten years / since 2015).

tl: Ang present perfect

Kapag may tiyak na oras sa nakaraan (yesterday, in 2010), past simple ang gamit.

en: Obligation and advice: must, have to, should

fr: Les phrases avec if (réel)

Condition possible : if + présent, will + verbe. If it rains, I will stay at home. On ne met jamais « will » après if.
Vérité générale : if + présent, présent. If you heat ice, it melts.
« Unless » = if … not ; « when » pour ce qui est certain.
en: If-sentences (real conditions)

Possible condition: if + present, will + verb. If it rains, I will stay at home. Never put “will” after if.
General truth: if + present, present. If you heat ice, it melts.
“Unless” = if … not; use “when” for what is certain.
es: Las frases con if (real)

Condición posible: if + presente, will + verbo. If it rains, I will stay at home. Nunca se pone «will» después de if.
Verdad general: if + presente, presente. If you heat ice, it melts.
«Unless» = if … not; «when» para lo que es seguro.
de: Bedingungssätze mit if (real)

Mögliche Bedingung: if + Präsens, will + Verb. If it rains, I will stay at home. Nach if steht nie „will“.
Allgemeine Wahrheit: if + Präsens, Präsens. If you heat ice, it melts.
„Unless“ = if … not; „when“ für Sicheres.
it: Le frasi con if (reale)

Condizione possibile: if + presente, will + verbo. If it rains, I will stay at home. Mai «will» dopo if.
Verità generale: if + presente, presente. If you heat ice, it melts.
«Unless» = if … not; «when» per ciò che è certo.
pt: As frases com if (real)

Condição possível: if + presente, will + verbo. If it rains, I will stay at home. Nunca se usa «will» depois de if.
Verdade geral: if + presente, presente. If you heat ice, it melts.
«Unless» = if … not; «when» para o que é certo.
ja: if を使う条件文（現実）

起こりうる条件：if + 現在形、will + 動詞。If it rains, I will stay at home。if の後に will は使いません。
一般的な真理：if + 現在形、現在形。If you heat ice, it melts。
unless は「if … not」、確実なことには when を使います。
zh: if 条件句（真实条件）

可能的条件：if + 一般现在时，will + 动词。If it rains, I will stay at home。if 后面不用 will。
普遍真理：if + 一般现在时，一般现在时。If you heat ice, it melts。
unless = if … not；确定会发生的事用 when。
ko: if 조건문 (현실)

가능한 조건: if + 현재형, will + 동사. If it rains, I will stay at home. if 뒤에는 절대 will을 쓰지 않습니다.
일반적인 진리: if + 현재형, 현재형. If you heat ice, it melts.
unless = if … not, 확실한 일에는 when을 씁니다.
lt: Sąlygos sakiniai su if (realūs)

Galima sąlyga: if + esamasis laikas, will + veiksmažodis. If it rains, I will stay at home. Po if niekada nevartojamas „will“.
Bendra tiesa: if + esamasis, esamasis. If you heat ice, it melts.
„Unless“ = if … not; „when“ – tam, kas tikra.
tl: Mga pangungusap na may if (totoo)

Posibleng kondisyon: if + kasalukuyan, will + pandiwa. If it rains, I will stay at home. Hindi kailanman ginagamit ang «will» pagkatapos ng if.
Pangkalahatang katotohanan: if + kasalukuyan, kasalukuyan. If you heat ice, it melts.
Ang «unless» = if … not; «when» para sa tiyak.

fr: Les relatives : who, which, that

« Who » pour les personnes, « which » pour les choses, « that » pour les deux dans la langue courante. « Whose » = dont (possession), « where » pour un lieu.
Quand le pronom est complément, on peut le supprimer : the book (that) I read.
en: Relative clauses: who, which, that

“Who” for people, “which” for things, “that” for both in everyday speech. “Whose” shows possession, “where” refers to a place.
When the pronoun is the object it can be dropped: the book (that) I read.
es: Las relativas: who, which, that

«Who» para personas, «which» para cosas, «that» para ambas en el lenguaje corriente. «Whose» = cuyo (posesión), «where» para un lugar.
Cuando el pronombre es complemento se puede omitir: the book (that) I read.
de: Relativsätze: who, which, that

„Who“ für Personen, „which“ für Dinge, „that“ umgangssprachlich für beides. „Whose“ = dessen / deren, „where“ für einen Ort.
Ist das Pronomen Objekt, kann es entfallen: the book (that) I read.
it: Le relative: who, which, that

«Who» per le persone, «which» per le cose, «that» per entrambe nella lingua corrente. «Whose» = il cui (possesso), «where» per un luogo.
Quando il pronome è complemento si può omettere: the book (that) I read.
pt: As relativas: who, which, that

«Who» para pessoas, «which» para coisas, «that» para ambas na língua corrente. «Whose» = cujo (posse), «where» para um lugar.
Quando o pronome é complemento pode ser omitido: the book (that) I read.
ja: 関係詞：who, which, that

人には who、物には which、話し言葉ではどちらにも that を使います。whose は所有、where は場所を表します。
関係代名詞が目的語のときは省略できます：the book (that) I read。
zh: 关系从句：who、which、that

人用 who，物用 which，口语中两者都可用 that。whose 表示所属，where 表示地点。
关系代词作宾语时可以省略：the book (that) I read。
ko: 관계사: who, which, that

사람에는 who, 사물에는 which, 일상 회화에서는 둘 다 that을 씁니다. whose는 소유, where는 장소를 나타냅니다.
관계대명사가 목적어일 때는 생략할 수 있습니다: the book (that) I read.
lt: Šalutiniai pažyminio sakiniai: who, which, that

„Who“ žmonėms, „which“ daiktams, „that“ šnekamojoje kalboje abiem. „Whose“ = kurio (priklausomybė), „where“ vietai.
Kai įvardis yra papildinys, jį galima praleisti: the book (that) I read.
tl: Mga sugnay na pang-uri: who, which, that

«Who» para sa tao, «which» para sa bagay, «that» para sa pareho sa karaniwang usapan. «Whose» = na may-ari, «where» para sa lugar.
Kapag layon ang panghalip, puwedeng alisin: the book (that) I read.

fr: Le passif

be + participe passé : The window was broken. L'agent est introduit par « by » (by a child).
On conjugue « be » au temps voulu : is made, was made, has been made, will be made.
L'anglais emploie le passif bien plus que le français : I was told… = on m'a dit…
en: The passive

be + past participle: The window was broken. The agent is introduced by “by” (by a child).
Conjugate “be” in the tense you need: is made, was made, has been made, will be made.
English also allows: I was told… / She was given a prize.
es: La voz pasiva

be + participio: The window was broken. El agente se introduce con «by» (by a child).
«Be» se conjuga en el tiempo necesario: is made, was made, has been made, will be made.
El inglés usa la pasiva mucho más que el español: I was told… = me dijeron…
de: Das Passiv

be + Partizip: The window was broken. Der Urheber wird mit „by“ angeschlossen (by a child).
„Be“ steht in der gewünschten Zeit: is made, was made, has been made, will be made.
Das Englische benutzt das Passiv oft, wo man im Deutschen „man“ sagt: I was told… = man hat mir gesagt…
it: Il passivo

be + participio: The window was broken. L'agente è introdotto da «by» (by a child).
«Be» si coniuga al tempo voluto: is made, was made, has been made, will be made.
L'inglese usa il passivo molto più dell'italiano: I was told… = mi hanno detto…
pt: A voz passiva

be + particípio: The window was broken. O agente é introduzido por «by» (by a child).
«Be» conjuga-se no tempo necessário: is made, was made, has been made, will be made.
O inglês usa a passiva muito mais que o português: I was told… = disseram-me…
ja: 受動態

be + 過去分詞：The window was broken。動作をする人は by で示します（by a child）。
be を必要な時制にします：is made, was made, has been made, will be made。
英語は受動態をよく使います：I was told…＝〜と言われた。
zh: 被动语态

be + 过去分词：The window was broken。动作执行者用 by 引出（by a child）。
be 按需要的时态变化：is made，was made，has been made，will be made。
英语比汉语更常用被动：I was told… = 有人告诉我……
ko: 수동태

be를 필요한 시제로 바꿉니다: is made, was made, has been made, will be made.
영어는 수동태를 자주 씁니다: I was told… = ~라고 들었다.
lt: Neveikiamoji rūšis

„Be“ asmenuojamas reikiamu laiku: is made, was made, has been made, will be made.
Anglai neveikiamąją rūšį vartoja dažnai: I was told… = man pasakė…
tl: Ang balintiyak (passive)

be + participle: The window was broken. Ipinapakilala ang gumawa gamit ang «by» (by a child).
Binabanghay ang «be» sa kailangang panahunan: is made, was made, has been made, will be made.

fr: L'irréel : would et would have

Irréel du présent : if + prétérit, would + verbe. If I had more time, I would travel. Avec be, on dit were à toutes les personnes : If I were you…
Irréel du passé : if + had + participe, would have + participe. If I had known, I would have come.
« I wish » suit la même logique : I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied.
en: Unreal conditions: would and would have

Unreal present: if + past simple, would + verb. If I had more time, I would travel. With be, use were for every person: If I were you…
Unreal past: if + had + participle, would have + participle. If I had known, I would have come.
“I wish” follows the same logic: I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied.
es: Lo irreal: would y would have

Irreal de presente: if + pasado simple, would + verbo. If I had more time, I would travel. Con be se dice were en todas las personas: If I were you…
Irreal de pasado: if + had + participio, would have + participio. If I had known, I would have come.
«I wish» sigue la misma lógica: I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied.
de: Das Irreale: would und would have

Irreale Gegenwart: if + Simple Past, would + Verb. If I had more time, I would travel. Bei be sagt man were in allen Personen: If I were you…
Irreale Vergangenheit: if + had + Partizip, would have + Partizip. If I had known, I would have come.
„I wish“ folgt derselben Logik: I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied.
it: L'irreale: would e would have

Irreale del presente: if + past simple, would + verbo. If I had more time, I would travel. Con be si dice were a tutte le persone: If I were you…
Irreale del passato: if + had + participio, would have + participio. If I had known, I would have come.
«I wish» segue la stessa logica: I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied.
pt: O irreal: would e would have

Irreal do presente: if + past simple, would + verbo. If I had more time, I would travel. Com be diz-se were em todas as pessoas: If I were you…
Irreal do passado: if + had + particípio, would have + particípio. If I had known, I would have come.
«I wish» segue a mesma lógica: I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied.
ja: 仮定法：would と would have

現在の事実に反する仮定：if + 過去形、would + 動詞。If I had more time, I would travel。be はどの人称でも were：If I were you…
過去の事実に反する仮定：if + had + 過去分詞、would have + 過去分詞。If I had known, I would have come。
I wish も同じ考え方です：I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied。
zh: 虚拟语气：would 与 would have

与现在事实相反：if + 一般过去时，would + 动词。If I had more time, I would travel。be 在所有人称都用 were：If I were you…
与过去事实相反：if + had + 过去分词，would have + 过去分词。If I had known, I would have come。
I wish 用法相同：I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied。
ko: 가정법: would와 would have

현재 사실의 반대: if + 과거형, would + 동사. If I had more time, I would travel. be는 모든 인칭에서 were: If I were you…
과거 사실의 반대: if + had + 과거분사, would have + 과거분사. If I had known, I would have come.

Nereali dabartis: if + paprastasis būtasis, would + veiksmažodis. If I had more time, I would travel. Su be visiems asmenims sakoma were: If I were you…
Nereali praeitis: if + had + dalyvis, would have + dalyvis. If I had known, I would have come.
„I wish“ remiasi ta pačia logika: I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied.
tl: Di-totoong kondisyon: would at would have

Di-totoo sa kasalukuyan: if + past simple, would + pandiwa. If I had more time, I would travel. Sa be, «were» sa lahat ng panauhan: If I were you…
Di-totoo sa nakaraan: if + had + participle, would have + participle. If I had known, I would have come.
Ganito rin ang «I wish»: I wish I were rich. I wish I had studied.

fr: Verbe en -ing ou infinitif ?

Certains verbes sont suivis de -ing : enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). D'autres de to + verbe : want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
Après une préposition, toujours -ing : before leaving, good at cooking.
Stop doing = arrêter de faire ; stop to do = s'arrêter pour faire. Remember doing = se souvenir d'avoir fait ; remember to do = penser à faire.
en: Verb-ing or infinitive?

Some verbs take -ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). Others take to + verb: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
After a preposition always use -ing: before leaving, good at cooking.
Stop doing = quit; stop to do = pause in order to do. Remember doing = recall; remember to do = not forget.
es: ¿Verbo en -ing o infinitivo?

Algunos verbos van seguidos de -ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). Otros de to + verbo: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
Tras una preposición, siempre -ing: before leaving, good at cooking.
Stop doing = dejar de hacer; stop to do = pararse para hacer. Remember doing = recordar haber hecho; remember to do = acordarse de hacer.
de: Verb mit -ing oder Infinitiv?

Manche Verben stehen mit -ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). Andere mit to + Verb: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
Nach einer Präposition immer -ing: before leaving, good at cooking.
Stop doing = aufhören zu tun; stop to do = anhalten, um zu tun. Remember doing = sich erinnern, etwas getan zu haben; remember to do = daran denken, etwas zu tun.
it: Verbo in -ing o infinito?

Alcuni verbi sono seguiti da -ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). Altri da to + verbo: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
Dopo una preposizione sempre -ing: before leaving, good at cooking.
Stop doing = smettere di fare; stop to do = fermarsi per fare. Remember doing = ricordare di aver fatto; remember to do = ricordarsi di fare.
pt: Verbo em -ing ou infinitivo?

Alguns verbos são seguidos de -ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). Outros de to + verbo: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
Depois de preposição, sempre -ing: before leaving, good at cooking.
Stop doing = parar de fazer; stop to do = parar para fazer. Remember doing = lembrar de ter feito; remember to do = lembrar-se de fazer.
ja: -ing 形か不定詞か

-ing 形をとる動詞：enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest（I enjoy reading）。to + 動詞をとる動詞：want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn（I want to go）。
前置詞の後は必ず -ing：before leaving, good at cooking。
stop doing = 〜するのをやめる、stop to do = 〜するために立ち止まる。remember doing = 〜したことを覚えている、remember to do = 忘れずに〜する。
zh: 动名词还是不定式？

有些动词后接 -ing：enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest（I enjoy reading）。有些后接 to + 动词：want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn（I want to go）。
介词后总是用 -ing：before leaving, good at cooking。
stop doing = 停止做某事；stop to do = 停下来去做某事。remember doing = 记得做过；remember to do = 记得要做。
ko: -ing인가 to부정사인가?

-ing를 쓰는 동사: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). to + 동사를 쓰는 동사: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
전치사 뒤에는 항상 -ing: before leaving, good at cooking.
stop doing = ~하는 것을 그만두다, stop to do = ~하려고 멈추다. remember doing = ~한 것을 기억하다, remember to do = 잊지 않고 ~하다.
lt: -ing forma ar bendratis?

Po kai kurių veiksmažodžių eina -ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). Po kitų – to + veiksmažodis: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
Po prielinksnio visada -ing: before leaving, good at cooking.
Stop doing = liautis daryti; stop to do = sustoti, kad padarytum. Remember doing = prisiminti, kad padarei; remember to do = nepamiršti padaryti.
tl: Pandiwang -ing o infinitive?

May mga pandiwang sinusundan ng -ing: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, keep, suggest (I enjoy reading). Ang iba ay ng to + pandiwa: want, decide, hope, need, promise, learn (I want to go).
Pagkatapos ng pang-ukol, laging -ing: before leaving, good at cooking.
Stop doing = tumigil sa paggawa; stop to do = huminto para gawin. Remember doing = maalala na ginawa; remember to do = huwag kalimutang gawin.

fr: Le discours indirect

Quand le verbe introducteur est au passé, les temps reculent d'un cran : présent → prétérit ("I am tired" → He said he was tired), prétérit → past perfect, will → would, can → could.
« Say » (dire quelque chose) / « tell » + personne (He told me that…).
Question indirecte : ordre sujet-verbe, sans do : She asked where I lived.
en: Reported speech

When the reporting verb is past, tenses shift back: present → past ("I am tired" → He said he was tired), past → past perfect, will → would, can → could.
“Say” something / “tell” + person (He told me that…).
Reported questions keep subject-verb order, with no do: She asked where I lived.
es: El estilo indirecto

Cuando el verbo introductor está en pasado, los tiempos retroceden un paso: presente → pasado ("I am tired" → He said he was tired), pasado → past perfect, will → would, can → could.
«Say» (decir algo) / «tell» + persona (He told me that…).
Pregunta indirecta: orden sujeto-verbo, sin do: She asked where I lived.
de: Die indirekte Rede

Steht das einleitende Verb in der Vergangenheit, rücken die Zeiten eine Stufe zurück: Präsens → Simple Past ("I am tired" → He said he was tired), Simple Past → Past Perfect, will → would, can → could.
„Say“ (etwas sagen) / „tell“ + Person (He told me that…).
Indirekte Frage: Subjekt vor Verb, ohne do: She asked where I lived.
it: Il discorso indiretto

Quando il verbo introduttivo è al passato, i tempi arretrano di un grado: presente → past simple ("I am tired" → He said he was tired), past simple → past perfect, will → would, can → could.
«Say» (dire qualcosa) / «tell» + persona (He told me that…).
Domanda indiretta: ordine soggetto-verbo, senza do: She asked where I lived.
pt: O discurso indireto

Quando o verbo introdutor está no passado, os tempos recuam um grau: presente → past simple ("I am tired" → He said he was tired), past simple → past perfect, will → would, can → could.
«Say» (dizer algo) / «tell» + pessoa (He told me that…).
Pergunta indireta: ordem sujeito-verbo, sem do: She asked where I lived.
ja: 間接話法

伝える動詞が過去形のとき、時制が一つ過去にずれます：現在 → 過去（"I am tired" → He said he was tired）、過去 → 過去完了、will → would、can → could。
say（〜と言う）/ tell + 人（He told me that…）。
間接疑問文は「主語＋動詞」の順で do は使いません：She asked where I lived。
zh: 间接引语

引述动词为过去时时，时态要往前推一步：现在时 → 过去时（"I am tired" → He said he was tired），过去时 → 过去完成时，will → would，can → could。
say（说某事）/ tell + 人（He told me that…）。
间接疑问句用陈述语序，不用 do：She asked where I lived。

lt: Netiesioginė kalba

Kai įvadinis veiksmažodis yra būtojo laiko, laikai pasislenka per vieną pakopą atgal: esamasis → būtasis ("I am tired" → He said he was tired), būtasis → būtasis atliktinis, will → would, can → could.
„Say“ (pasakyti ką) / „tell“ + asmuo (He told me that…).
Netiesioginis klausimas: veiksnys prieš veiksmažodį, be do: She asked where I lived.
tl: Di-tuwirang pananalita

Kapag nasa nakaraan ang pandiwang nagpapakilala, umaatras ng isang hakbang ang panahunan: kasalukuyan → nakaraan ("I am tired" → He said he was tired), nakaraan → past perfect, will → would, can → could.
«Say» (magsabi ng bagay) / «tell» + tao (He told me that…).
Di-tuwirang tanong: simuno bago pandiwa, walang do: She asked where I lived.

fr: L'inversion et l'emphase

Dans un style soutenu, un adverbe négatif en tête de phrase entraîne l'inversion : Never have I seen such a thing. Not only did he come, but he also helped. Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
Pour insister sur un élément, on emploie une phrase clivée : It was John who called. What I need is a holiday.
en: Inversion and emphasis

In formal style a negative adverb at the start of the sentence triggers inversion: Never have I seen such a thing. Not only did he come, but he also helped. Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
To stress one element, use a cleft sentence: It was John who called. What I need is a holiday.
